categories_thin: Group B (health and personal care): only two storefront personal-care businesses (a hair salon and a nail salon in Sutton Plaza) plus one unverified martial-arts registry name. No dentist, physician, chiropractor, physical therapist, optometrist, veterinarian, med spa, barber or fitness studio operates at a Helmetta address; every such 'Helmetta' listing resolves to Jamesburg, Spotswood, Monroe or East Brunswick.

Group A (professional and office services): no law office, insurance agency, real estate brokerage office, title agency or wealth adviser located in Helmetta. Only two small tax practices, one appraiser and registered-but-unlisted entities (IT, consulting, marketing, appraisal, private investigation).

Group D retail: no independent shop of any size except a garden center, a dry cleaner and a home-based gift/plant listing. No furniture, jewelry, clothing, hardware, appliance, bike, music or gift storefront; no funeral home, hotel, printer/sign shop, or dance/music/art school in the borough.

Group D manufacturing/warehouse: no industrial or warehouse space is marketed in 08828 (LoopNet/Showcase results all point to Spotswood/Monroe), so manufacturing, labs and logistics are registry names only with no verifiable Helmetta facility.

Group C: coverage is dominated by home-based licensed trades (plumbing, electrical, painting, landscaping, remodeling). Only about half a dozen show any review volume or website; most are single-directory or registry-only.
caveats: Helmetta is a 0.8 sq mi borough of roughly 2,450 residents. Its commercial base is essentially Sutton Plaza (2 Old Forge Rd), a handful of Main St parcels (4, 28, 52, 56, 58, 66, 104) and a small Lake Ave cluster. The list is short by design, not truncated.

Many entries are home-based contractors whose published business address is a residential street; only business names, published business addresses and published business phones are recorded - no personal names, personal numbers or family details.

About 35 entries rest only on the state business-entity registry mirror (city-data.com) and are labelled 'One directory only'. Their operating status, address and trade are unconfirmed; many Helmetta-registered entities are likely dormant single-owner LLCs.

Superior Fence & Rail of Central Jersey (4 Main St, Suite 1) is excluded as a franchise location of a national fence brand. It is nonetheless the highest-review 'contractor' at a Helmetta address (5.0 / 140 reviews on Birdeye).
Gasland Gas Station (28 Main St) is included but flagged as borderline (fuel retail with convenience items).

28 Main St appears to host several auto businesses across directories (The Corner Auto Service, Anuj Auto Care, HMG Auto Repair, Three Brothers One in Glory). Each has its own listing so each is listed; some may be successors at the same bays.

Phone numbers came from directory snippets and were not dialled. Conflicting numbers exist for at least T & R Alarm and Electrical Systems (two different 973 numbers appear in different directories), so treat phones as leads to verify, not confirmed contacts.
Allegiance Garden Center's site says the store is on Main Street in Helmetta while its contact page now shows an East Brunswick office - possible relocation or a second office (inference).
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap Overpass API was unreachable from this environment (fetch failed), so no map-based completeness check of the borough was possible.

Google web search returned a CAPTCHA, DuckDuckGo returned a bot challenge, and Google Maps served a 'limited view' with about five results per query that were centred on neighbouring towns - no exhaustive map sweep was possible.

Yellow Pages, SuperPages, AllPages, Manta, D&B, BBB category pages, ChamberOfCommerce.com, CitySquares, BuildZoom, LocalSolution, Cylex, Hotfrog, Brownbook and ShowMeLocal all returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare walls to both the fetch tool and the browser; their data was usable only through search-snippet summaries.
Helmetta Borough's website has no business directory, licensed-business list or economic-development page, and the regional CNJ Chamber member directory could not be opened.

About 130 further registry entities were not individually researched: holding and investment LLCs, family partnerships, HOAs, nonprofits (fire department, historical society, political and cultural associations) and one-owner trucking LLCs (Criter, CRS, Leao, MKJ, McCoy, Tadros, Wilson, Bluecat, Moondancer, Hailey, FC Truck Services, Tertrans and similar). They hold Helmetta addresses but are unlikely to be reviewable local businesses.
No municipal list of home-improvement registrations or trade licences by town is publicly queryable, so contractor completeness inside Helmetta cannot be guaranteed.
